notes: The spec declares itself a turn-based strategy resource-management board game and describes a 19-tile hex island with vertices and edges, which is Strategy's Board & Card Games preset without argument. The answer confirms a table-sized board with a static angled top-down camera and no walkable arena, so stage B lands on a real build nobody walks on: P0 plus SET, skipping traversal and jump-gap validation while still building the tiles, number tokens, player-coloured settlements, cities, roads and the robber pawn. board-grid is the shape and tile-grid the board surface, bent from squares to the standard 3-4-5-4-3 hex rows with the stated tile colours. Everything else the spec pins down — dice, phases, costs, RemoteEvents, HUD and audio — is gameplay and UI rather than layout, so I carried none of it into options and added nothing the spec did not name.
